title: Fix Sketchpad Import Resolution
description: Fix the sketchpad Vite build error: Failed to resolve import "@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react" from "../../ui/index.tsx". The sketchpad imports @compose/ui which transitively imports this MCP package that isn't available in the sketchpad context. Need to fix the import resolution.
summary: The `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` package was declared in both the root `package.json` and `@compose/ui/package.json` but was not actually installed in `node_modules`. Running `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` resolved the missing dependency. The sketchpad's Vite build now succeeds (4039 modules transformed) and the dev server starts cleanly on port 5173.
